title: Patient Balances, Adjustment Reasons and Credit Refunds on Wound Care Supply Program Accounts
content:
# Patient balance, adjustments and refunds — Wound Care Supply Program

Patient Financial Services policy on the customer's balance on a wound care program.

## 1. The balance

The customer's balance on the program is the running total of its patient-balance postings: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds add to it, and payments and balance adjustments reduce it; a payment is applied to the oldest unpaid posting first. A balance below zero is a credit balance.

*Hypothetical example.* A posting of USD 40.00 from January and a posting of USD 60.00 from February are unpaid. A payment of USD 50.00 clears the January posting first and then USD 10.00 of the February posting, leaving USD 50.00 unpaid on the February posting.

## 2. Balance adjustments

A balance adjustment is posted only for one of these reasons, each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder:

| Reason | Use |
|---|---|
| return credit | an accepted self-pay return, for the price paid for the returned units less the restocking fee percent |
| secondary payer payment | the amount a secondary payer paid against a remittance's patient responsibility |
| hardship waiver | a financial-hardship waiver under clause 3 |
| small-balance write-off | a write-off under clause 4 |
| billing correction | a posting made in error, or a timely-filing write-off |

## 3. Hardship waiver

A hardship waiver is granted only on tiers where a hardship waiver is allowed, only for postings named on a hardship application whose request status is approved, and only after Larkfield's financial counseling team confirms household income at or below the tier's hardship income ceiling, as a percent of the HHS poverty guideline; it is never granted routinely, never advertised and never granted on the customer's statement alone.

All three conditions are read from the records: the tier, the approved hardship application naming the posting, and the financial counseling team's confirmation of income.

## 4. Small-balance write-off

A small-balance write-off is made only when the whole remaining balance of the program is greater than 0.00 and no more than the tier's small-balance write-off figure; on tiers where that figure is 0.00 no write-off is made and the balance is statemented.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a tier whose figure is USD 4.99).*

| Whole remaining balance | Write-off |
|---|---|
| USD 4.99 | Yes |
| USD 5.00 | No — above the figure |
| USD 0.00 | No — not greater than 0.00 |

## 5. Credit balances

A credit balance is refunded to the original payment method no later than the tier's credit-balance refund limit, in calendar days, after the posting date of the entry that created it, unless the customer asks in writing to keep it on account; a refund never exceeds the credit.

*Hypothetical example.* A credit created by a payment posted 2026-09-01 on a tier with a 30-day limit is refunded no later than 2026-10-01.
